title: PID limits and missing statistics
summary: PID exhaustion can prevent child creation even when the main process remains running. Container PID limits and counters must be visible; an unlimited or absent limit cannot provide configured headroom.
checks: Check configured PID headroom and compare host-level process limits separately.
Repeat from the approved daemon vantage if cgroup statistics are unavailable.
limitations: No process command lines are collected. Unsupported or absent counters remain unknown.
